authors: Konstantin Stracke, Connor W. Edwards, Jack D. Evans
title: Evaluating mechanical property prediction across material classes using molecular dynamics simulations with universal machine-learned interatomic potentials
note: Item 17 (bulk modulus + thermal expansion from MD): six uMLIPs (best MACE-MP-0a, fairchem OMAT, Orb-v3) on 9 MOFs and 4 inorganic compounds. Another thermal-expansion option: Solovykh, Rybin, Novikov, Shapeev, arXiv:2505.14245 (PIMD for LiH and Si, compared with MatterSim).
